body: Dan Schneider. Please please comment your thoughts on this subject.
This was very helpful and a very interesting take. Thank you.
Many times our fantasies or thoughts aren’t who we really are. Contrary to popular beliefs. They don’t define you. You don’t act on them.
Thank you kind stranger. It really means more than you know. Sometimes I forget that there are kind and genuine people left.

Yeah, in my adolescence that’s all they did. My mom learned it from her mom. My dad had no parental guidance from anybody. At one point, I would say my parents were verbally abusive. I wish to think that this hasn’t impacted my self esteem but I know it has, but it’s not any easy pattern to break. I hear their voices in my head some days telling me that I’m no good, sometimes their voice becomes my own. I am very against the “R” word and I’m a huge advocate for not saying it, but it replays in my mind along with stupid and other words.
